history.summary: 1,270 sqft 4BR at St Francis Court, a tiny 71-unit, 99yr-from-1992 leasehold completed 1994 (32 years old) near Boon Keng. The headline 9.1%/yr CAGR is unreliable (only 22 txns) and the listing at $1,268 psf sits above the $1,185 median; score_1000 is just 398.
history.rating_rationale: This is an old (1994), small 71-unit leasehold with ~66 years of lease left — financing and resale both tighten as lease decays. The 9.1%/yr rate is a thin-data artefact (22 txns) and the asking $1,268 psf is ~7% ABOVE the $1,185 URA median. Web research confirms recent transactions at $1,002-$1,192 psf, so this listing is priced above the market. Score_1000 of 398 is a clear value/quality warning. En-bloc is the only real catalyst and it is speculative (the development has been floated for collective sale but nothing committed).
red_flags: Listed ~7% above URA median PSF and above all verified recent transactions ($1,002-$1,192 psf)
